description: This file defines the main React component 'MindmapClient' for a mind map exploration interface, including state management, API interactions, and UI rendering for a career navigation app.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Utility function to constrain a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filter settings for the mind map based on salary, skills, and time horizon.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Provides default view state including pan, zoom, and filter settings.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Sanitizes and restores a saved view state, ensuring validity.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts various error types into user-readable message strings.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a persistent unique key for the user, used for view state tracking.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the reason why the graph view might be empty, for user feedback.
